title: Supplemental Thyroxine Treatment for Preterm Infants With Hypothyroxinemia
brief_summary: In order to determine the efficacy and safety of thyroxine replacement, a randomized clinical trial of thyroxine supplementation for VLBW infant with hypothyroxinemia during the first month of age is conducted.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Birth weight: less than 1500g
* Gestation: 22 weeks 0 day ≤
* Serum free thyroxine level lower than 0.8 ng/dl
* Serum thyrotropin lower than 10 μU/ml
* Age of between 2 and 4 weeks after birth
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* any known thyroid disease in mother
